en: Do you truly intend to defeat me?
Yes.
It's true that I've come here to defeat you.
note: Printed on the same line as A0C, hence trailing space.

en: So that you may rest in eternal sleep.
Very well.
Then you shall learn the extent of my power.
Because we failed to finish off the vampire
in Calstatt, its power
seems to have grown...
We'd better do something about it, and soon.
Vampires are... pitiful creatures, you know.
You see, in exchange for being spared death,
they must live on, bearing eternal suffering.
Freeing them from that suffering
is our mission as well...
And we must not let humans suffer
any more victims...
We cannot allow any more tragedy!
To bring the vampire down, I have prepared
several means of doing so...
Holy water, holy stakes, crosses.
On my instructions, each of them has been
given to the other hunters to carry...
We made sure the vampire's coffin had been
loaded as cargo, you see... and traced where it was headed.
Its destination: London, England...
Once Harker confirmed it, he and I
got ahead of it and came on to London first.
That's how we come to be here.
Crosses have the power to purify
note: Speaker not identified (a doctor: Seward or Van Helsing).

en: people who have been turned into vampires.
Day or night, whatever vampires I find,
I make a point of purifying them...
In a doctor's terms, this would
count as treating a patient.
Have we met somewhere before?
note: Speaker not identified (a hunter recognising the player; perhaps Harker). Player answers in 584-550.

en: Could you be...?
Aren't you imagining things?
I have no recollection
of ever meeting you.
To think the vampire was after
London all along...
Miss Rose, who was to be my fiancée...
May no danger be drawing near her...
I can't help but pray for that.
Blessed sword, holy water...
note: Speaker inferred as Harker (glossary: blessed sword, holy water).

en: These are my weapons for fighting vampires.
Damn, to think we meekly let the vampire
land in the British Empire...
But the real fight starts now!
We five hunters will do all we can
to thwart the vampire's schemes!!
Just wandering around blindly won't let us
defeat the vampire...
We must gather information from residents
and look into any suspicious places...
Now that the great Morris has arrived,
the vampire won't get its way anymore!
By day, I go around setting garlic
in people's homes.
It may just be garlic, but don't you
go underestimating it!
Put this in a house, and the vampire
can't drink blood there at night...
It can also sap the power of Nosferatu
and Dhampir, too...
Truth is, I'm just repeating what
Professor Van Helsing told me.
This time... it won't be a seal. You'll be
note: Christopher (polite) to Duran: Duran was sealed before.

en: going into eternal sleep.
Do you honestly think that I would bother
taking on the likes of you?
Heh... well, do as you please.
Your persistence in coming this far, at least,
deserves my praise.
I hear Nosferatu and Dhampir have often
been appearing around these parts.
Have you heard any such rumors?
